WAD SCHEMA FIX — test_first_breath_world_query (#4 baseline failure)

CONTEXT: Web research (docs/research/WEB_RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE_GAPS_20260717.md) confirms:
extra='forbid' is correct for security. Do NOT loosen it. Instead, use a versioned
schema with optional heritage fields.

VICTIM: tests/test_world_state.py::test_first_breath_world_query
ERROR: "WAD arcana_novai manifest has unknown fields: ['author', 'dependencies', 
'description', 'license', 'mode', 'requires_engine', 'startup', 'type', 'voices', 
'vr_scenes']"

ROOT CAUSE: src/omega/oracle/wad_loader.py validates WAD manifests with
Pydantic model that has extra='forbid'. The arcana_novai IWAD manifest has
10 fields the schema doesn't know about.

FIX (2 approaches — pick one):
A. Add an allowed_extra_fields set to WadManifest that silently accepts known
   heritage fields without breaking extra='forbid' security
B. Create a versioned WadManifestV2 schema with the heritage fields explicitly
   defined

PREFERRED: Option B — versioned schema. The WAD manifest has a 'version' field
already (the error shows "Known fields: ['adapters', 'entities', 'name', 'version']").
If version >= 2, use WadManifestV2 with optional heritage fields. This preserves
extra='forbid' for v1 manifests and explicitly validates v2 fields.

GATE: test_first_breath_world_query passes
SCOPE: Single file fix in wad_loader.py
PRIORITY: Sidecar to Phase III — same target files, same agent
